# Composio

> > Composio is a production-ready integration platform for AI agents, providing OAuth 2.0 authentication, MCP servers, and tool orchestration for connecting agents to 100+ external services including Gmail, Slack, Salesforce, and Notion.

Composio enables developers to build AI agents with enterprise-grade integrations through standardized protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) and OAuth 2.0. The platform offers pre-built connectors, authentication management, and workflow automation tools for AI agent development across frameworks like LlamaIndex and Claude.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- OAuth 2.0 Authentication
- Integration Platform
- Tool Invocation
- Workflow Automation
- Enterprise Authentication
- API Integration
- Production-Ready Integrations
- Agent Architecture
- Claude 3.7 Sonnet
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- SWE-bench
- Function Calling
- B2B SaaS Integrations
